description: What a knowledge base says about itself, answered by the Archivist from the committed .semiont/config and the working tree it holds. The only source clients use for a knowledge base's name and domain.

name.description: The committed [project] name, or the knowledge base directory's name when none is declared.

domain.description: The committed [site] domain: the knowledge base's permanent identity. Its did is 'did:web:' + this domain (kbDid in @semiont/core). It names WHICH knowledge base this is, not which running copy: a local clone and a codespace of one repo report the same domain, so use it to verify what you connected to, never to select among copies. A knowledge base that declares none is refused with browse:kb-failed.

gitBranch.description: The working tree's current git branch. Absent when the tree is not a git checkout.
